title: Ex-Catholics and the fallen away
tagline: Why people leave, how to listen without defending, and how to invite them home.
whyItMatters: Most people who leave the Church do not leave because of one argument, and many are hurting. A listening friend and an open door matter more than a perfect reply.

mindset.tip: Listen before you speak: ask for their story and do not defend yet. (James 1:19)
People leave for many reasons, such as disbelief, hurt or drift; ask which it is before you reply.
Remember the father of the Prodigal Son who ran to meet his child; offer welcome, not pressure. (Luke 15:20; CCC 1439)
Own the Church's real failings with honesty; she is holy and always in need of purification. (CCC 827)
Invite gently to the sacrament of Reconciliation as the door back, and walk with them. (CCC 1422, 1440)
